title: He Will Hold Me Fast
lyrics_original: When I fear my faith will fail,
I could never keep my hold
For my love is often cold;
For my Savior loves me so,
Those He saves are His delight,
He’ll not let my soul be lost;
Bought by Him at such a cost,
For my Savior loves me so,
For my life He bled and died,
Raised with Him to endless life,
‘Till our faith is turned to sight
For my Savior loves me so,

bible_verses.english: Now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You that my security is held safely in Your unwavering hands. When fear creeps in and my faith feels fragile, remind me that Your love never lets me go. Forgive me for relying on my own strength when my heart grows cold. I place my trust in You again today, knowing that You will faithfully hold me fast. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: We often worry whether our faith will be strong enough to endure life's storms, but this comforting hymn reminds us where our true security lies. Our hope does not rest in how tightly we hold onto Jesus, but in how faithfully He holds onto us. Even when your love feels cold or your steps stumble, His unfailing grace remains your anchor. Take a deep breath today and rest in the peaceful truth that the Savior who bought you will keep you safely to the very end.
